# Share

<!-- Generated by tools/make_qr.py from share/links.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

QR codes for ATAK: scan with the phone camera (or a QR app) and open with ATAK, which asks before importing. The `tak://` links only work on Android devices with ATAK; for iTAK and WinTAK use the https link.

> **Suomeksi:** skannaa QR-koodi puhelimen kameralla ja avaa ATAKilla. iTAK ja WinTAK: käytä https-linkkiä.
